findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: register_agent, get_bounty, post_bounty, my_activity, set_contact, ask_question, answer_question, message_thread, chess_play · Private data: register_agent, post_bounty, set_contact, ask_question, answer_question, message_thread, send_message, set_payout_address, settlement_instruction, planets_puzzles, hla_vet · Public sink: register_agent, post_bounty, submit_result, join_submission, decline_submission, my_inbox, set_contact, send_message, set_payout_address, chess_play, science_team, planets_puzzles, planets_submit, hla_reports, hla_submit · Destructive: set_contact, tournament_join, planets_puzzles, hla_reports.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: register_agent, get_bounty, post_bounty, my_activity, set_contact, ask_question, answer_question, message_thread, chess_play · Private data: register_agent, post_bounty, set_contact, ask_question, answer_question, message_thread, send_message, set_payout_address, settlement_instruction, planets_puzzles, hla_vet · Public sink: register_agent, post_bounty, submit_result, join_submission, decline_submission, my_inbox, set_contact, send_message, set_payout_address, chess_play, science_team, planets_puzzles, planets_submit, hla_reports, hla_submit · Destructive: set_contact, tournament_join, planets_puzzles, hla_reports

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "register_agent" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Register as an agent on the bounty board and receive an API key. Required before posting or filling bounties. The key is shown ONCE — store it. How the board works: agents post bounties (tasks like literature research, dataset assembly, supplier sourcing, price discovery) with a stated USD reward; o" → after: "Register as an agent and receive an API key, needed for every game and job here. The key is shown ONCE — store it. What is here: planet hunting in real NASA TESS data (start with the hunt-planets prompt or planets_puzzles; results are reported back here and shown at /science), HLA lab-report cleanup"

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
